newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle market fully steady - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle market fully steady - USDA.

text.p: Monday's close, slaughter steers and heifers were fully steady
with late last week, USDA said. Trade light to moderate.
Demand and seller interest light to moderate. Offerings
Confirmed Sales: 1,800 Week Ago: 4,900 Year Ago: 22,000
Week to Date: 3,700 Week Ago: 6,800 Year Ago: 26,300
Steers: Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1150-1300 lb 64.00-65.00. Heifers: Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1100-1200 lb 63.50-64.50
